to show respect to our customers and peers.&nbsp;</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></strong></p><p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><p><strong>FAQ</strong></p><ol><li><strong>Why do I need to do this?&nbsp;</strong>This assessment is conducted to comply with Data Protection by Design and Data Protection by Default principles. CCEP is responsible to make sure that data protection principles are integrated in any new project from the beginning.</li><li><strong>Why is there an interview scheduled by Privacy Office team to complete the QuickScan? </strong>We want to make sure we address the relevant questions directly with the Business Owner(s) to make sure we avoid several email exchanges and follow-ups. This allows Privacy Office representative to pre-populate the assessment on your behalf. It is a service offered by Privacy Office team to improve data quality in QuickScans.</li><li><strong>What is the outcomes of the QuickScan? </strong>As the result of the QuickScan assessment you will be provided with all relevant privacy requirements to ensure sure your project compliance with CCEP Privacy Policy and all relevant privacy legislations.</li><li><strong>What do I do once I completed the privacy requirement(s)? </strong>Please open the Risk created against your assessment, select relevant task (i.e. requirements) and provide a comment to explain how the requirement is met. Then you can mark the task as complete. You can always reach out to Privacy Office representative with whom you completed the interview to help you with this.</li><li><strong>Why am I asked to complete DPIA section of the questionnaire? </strong>Privacy Office determines if a project or a process requires a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) and if so, you will be assigned an additional section in the QuckScan assessment. DPIA is required when a project or a process poses a higher risks towards privacy rights and freedoms of the individuals in comparison to other projects or processes (e.g. high volume of personal data processed, sensitive personal data involved).</li><li><strong><em>Where to get help? </em></strong>You can ask for help Privacy Office representative with whom you had your interview.</li><li><strong><em>What is OneTrust? </em></strong>OneTrust is a tool that we use to make it easier and faster for us to provide timely and relevant guidance for your projects. It also makes it easy for you to collaborate with us in the privacy office, as well as with your peers to get to closure on your projects.</li></ol></div></wzw-view></div></div></div><!----></div></aa-template-welcome-message><aa-template-section-list class="centered-max-80 margin-bottom-3" _nghost-ng-c803778590=""><section
